0.0: I wonder, then, if #p1032102# knew of my troubles? You see, I've been working on improving my debate skills, but I have been interrupted by #r#o9100014#s#k appearing more frequently near #m101000000#. #r#o9100014##k near #m101000000#... Odd, is it not?
0.1: These foul Axe Stumps have been threatening me with their axes. They even took a little chunk out of me last time! This cannot be allowed to continue.
0.2: I will send you to where those brutish #r#o9100014#s#k are hiding, and I will ask that you kindly eliminate 40 of them. I am sure they will not bother me anymore after that. Because they will be gone.

1.0: Ah, you have returned! Did you eliminate those #o9100014#s?

yes.0: Splendid. You are indeed as kind as I had hoped. No wonder #p1032102# counts you as her friend.

default.0: Those #r#o9100014#s#k are lurking around #m101000000# even now... Be careful when you face them. If you want to return to the #r#o9100014#s#k' Hideout, you must abandon the quest and accept it again. Of course, you will have to start over and eliminate #r40 Stumps#k again...
